name: replaced
note: css-sizing-4 §5.3 on replaced elements: aspect-ratio: auto keeps the attribute-derived size (200x100); an explicit ratio replaces the natural ratio — with both CSS dimensions auto the natural size maps through the new ratio keeping the dimension whose transfer yields the smaller box (1/1 on a 200x100 natural size → 100x100; 4/1 → 200x50, probe-verified). The computed aspect-ratio strings pin Chrome's serialization ('auto', '1 / 1'). The imgs are display:block so the boxes stack without line-box struts: this engine's UA defaults make img block-level, a pre-existing divergence from Chrome's inline replaced elements that this slice does not change. Chrome paints a placeholder frame on source-less imgs that the engine (no image decoding in v1) does not reproduce — the img border boxes are declared maskElements per the harness convention.
